about: FIBA's men's national-team results, 2023–2026, as English Wikipedia's article pages show them (scripts/sync-fiba-results.mjs, scripts/data/fiba-results-sources.json): every game played of the 2023 World Cup (classification included), the 2024 Olympic qualifying tournaments and Olympic tournament, the 2025 continental championships and the 2027 World Cup's qualifiers and pre-qualifiers so far. A game is [date, competition, side A, side B, A's points, B's points, overtimes, home: A, B or N for neutral, venue as the page gives it]; overtime points count in the score. Each page is [title read, page shown, revision, address, games].

source.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (the articles' text and tables); the results themselves are facts
source.terms: robots.txt allows /wiki/ for every agent this project's requests answer to (ClaudeBot and anthropic-ai among them); read 2026-11-21 through scripts/lib/polite-fetch.mjs, one page at a time
